hooks.text: 在骰子工厂里把点数一路滚到一百万，才能找到逃生机会
hooks.excerpt: Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point . (get it?!) You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 组合120多种骰子效果，用骰袋协同跨过不断上涨的债务与Boss
hooks.excerpt: Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies . Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 为手牌装备80多枚常驻戒指，让被动效果不断改写骰子结果
hooks.excerpt: Gear up your hand with more than 80 unique rings with that will act as your passive items. They're always active and trigger wacky effects in your dice.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
